rubric.item: The saved title is reported from the tool result, with the erp_url as a link.
rubric.note: Reports the new title with write_result succeeded and no pending steps, and includes the erp_url https://erp.example.test/app/products/prod_cv01.

rubric.item: The product page is opened once, without being asked (when the SKU is first read or after the save); the answer says it was opened and that review and publication happen there.
rubric.note: host.open_url ran once, unprompted, after get_product. The answer says the page is open, tells the user to refresh it to see the saved title, and says publication still happens in the ERP.

rubric.item: Nothing is done inside the opened page: no save, submit or publish is claimed, and nothing is described as published.
rubric.note: The answer claims no action inside the page and leaves publication to the user.

rubric.item: No unrelated field is changed or mentioned as changed.
rubric.note: The write sent only product_id and title. The answer says price, images and description were not touched.

agent_unsure: It treated the request as a catalog title edit because only a SKU was given, and offered to also change the Amazon ES listing title if the user supplies a listing_id.
